subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off local TUI completion notifier, and if so which modes and platform backends should be supported first?
rationale: The request is useful TUI ergonomics, but it adds new user-facing behavior and config/default surface, so automation should not choose the notification contract or platform scope.

options.title: Define a default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-scoped TUI feature that chooses a small mode set, safe desktop/bell behavior, config keys, docs, and tests.

options.title: Fold alerts into the watchdog design
options.body: Treat local completion alerts as a downstream consumer of the broader session activity watchdog instead of adding a TUI-specific notification path now.

options.title: Decline core TUI alerts
options.body: Leave desktop sounds to node notifications, OS wrappers, or plugins if maintainers decide platform-specific completion alerts are outside core.

recommendation.title: Define a default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-scoped TUI feature that chooses a small mode set, safe desktop/bell behavior, config keys, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-surface history across TUI lifecycle behavior, TUI docs, and config-schema areas relevant to choosing the product boundary.
